definitions.explanation: Kansai dialect equivalent of {本当|ほんとう}. Used to emphasize truth or express genuine feelings.

examples.japanese: ほんま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧わ。
ほんま？⟦{信|しん}じられ→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧へん。
⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧、ほんま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧？

notes:
DIALECT:
Kansai (⟦{関西|かんさい}→関西：00179_kansai⟧) dialect, primarily used in Osaka, Kyoto, and surrounding regions.

STANDARD EQUIVALENT:
⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧ / ⟦ほんと→ほんと：08758_honto⟧ (standard Japanese)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ほんま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - really (adverb)
- ほんま⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ - real, true (adjective)
- ほんま？ - Really? (question)
- ほんまや - That's true (affirmation)

USAGE:
⟦{関西弁|かんさいべん}→関西弁：17855_kansaiben⟧ has become widely recognized throughout Japan due to TV comedians and media. ほんま is one of the most commonly understood Kansai expressions.

RELATED DIALECT WORDS:
- ⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦やん→やん：29708_yan⟧ - No way! / You're kidding!
- ⟦まじ→マジ：04744_maji⟧で - Really/Seriously (youth slang, nationwide)
